title: 148. Quantitative Relationships & Measurement: Simple Interest Calculation
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate simple interest given principal, annual rate, and time.
questions.question: Find the simple interest on \(1{,}000\text{ yuan}\) at an annual rate of \(5\%\) for \(2\text{ years}\).
questions.explanation: Use the simple interest formula \(I=Prt\). Here \(P=1{,}000\), \(r=0.05\), and \(t=2\). Thus \(I=1{,}000\times 0.05\times 2=100\). Therefore, the simple interest is \(100\text{ yuan}\). Option A comes from using only one year.
questions.hint: Distinguish the principal, the interest earned, and the final amount.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the total amount after simple interest is added to the principal.
questions.question: A principal of \(2{,}000\text{ yuan}\) earns simple interest at \(4\%\) per year for \(3\text{ years}\). What is the total amount after the \(3\text{ years}\)?
questions.explanation: Simple interest is \(I=2{,}000\times 0.04\times 3=240\text{ yuan}\), so the total is \(2{,}000+240=2{,}240\text{ yuan}\). The alternative \(2{,}080\text{ yuan}\) adds only one year of interest: \(2{,}000+2{,}000\times 0.04\).
questions.hint: Express the duration in the units of the annual rate.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the annual simple interest rate from principal, interest, and time.
questions.question: A principal of \(1{,}000\text{ yuan}\) earns \(150\text{ yuan}\) in simple interest over \(3\text{ years}\). What is the annual interest rate?
questions.explanation: Using \(I=Prt\), solve for \(r\): \(r=\frac{I}{Pt}=\frac{150}{1{,}000\times 3}=\frac{150}{3{,}000}=0.05=5\%\). Therefore, the annual rate is \(5\%\). Option B is the total three-year rate, not the annual rate.
questions.hint: Simple interest uses the original principal throughout the stated time.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the time needed to earn a given simple interest.
questions.question: How many years are needed for \(1{,}500\text{ yuan}\) to earn \(300\text{ yuan}\) in simple interest at \(4\%\) per year?
questions.explanation: The annual simple interest is \(1{,}500\times 0.04=60\text{ yuan}\). Earning \(300\text{ yuan}\) takes \(\frac{300}{60}=5\text{ years}\). The alternative computes \(\frac{300}{1{,}500}=0.2\) and treats it as a time, omitting the annual rate.
questions.hint: Distinguish the principal, the interest earned, and the final amount.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the principal needed to earn a given simple interest.
questions.question: What principal earns \(480\text{ yuan}\) in simple interest at \(6\%\) per year over \(4\text{ years}\)?
questions.explanation: The principal is \(\frac{480}{0.06\times 4}=2{,}000\text{ yuan}\). The alternative omits the duration: \(\frac{480}{0.06}=8{,}000\text{ yuan}\).
questions.hint: Express the duration in the units of the annual rate.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the total amount when principal, rate, and time are given.
questions.question: A principal of \(5{,}000\text{ yuan}\) is invested at \(3.5\%\) simple interest per year for \(2\text{ years}\). What is the total amount after \(2\text{ years}\)?
questions.explanation: The interest is \(I=5{,}000\times 0.035\times 2=350\). The total amount is \(5{,}000+350=5{,}350\text{ yuan}\). Therefore, the total amount is \(5{,}350\text{ yuan}\). Option A is the total after only one year.
questions.hint: Simple interest uses the original principal throughout the stated time.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate simple interest when time is given in months.
questions.question: Find the simple interest on \(12{,}000\text{ yuan}\) at \(6\%\) per year for \(9\) months.
questions.explanation: Convert \(9\) months to years: \(t=\frac{9}{12}=0.75\). Then \(I=12{,}000\times 0.06\times 0.75=540\). Therefore, the simple interest is \(540\text{ yuan}\). Option B is the interest for a full year.
questions.hint: Express the duration in the units of the annual rate.

questions.learningObjective: Determine which of two investments earns less simple interest.
questions.question: Investment A: \(2{,}000\text{ yuan}\) at \(5\%\) per year for \(3\text{ years}\). Investment B: \(3{,}000\text{ yuan}\) at \(3\%\) per year for \(2\text{ years}\). Which investment earns less simple interest?
questions.explanation: For Investment A, \(I=2{,}000\times 0.05\times 3=300\text{ yuan}\). For Investment B, \(I=3{,}000\times 0.03\times 2=180\text{ yuan}\). Since \(180<300\), Investment B earns less simple interest. Therefore, the correct choice is Investment B.
questions.hint: Express the duration in the units of the annual rate.

questions.concept: Simple Interest Rate from Total Amount
questions.learningObjective: Determine the annual simple interest rate when the total amount is known.
questions.question: A principal of \(800\text{ yuan}\) grows to \(912\text{ yuan}\) after \(2\text{ years}\) with simple interest. What is the annual interest rate?
questions.explanation: The interest is \(912-800=112\text{ yuan}\). The annual rate is \(\frac{112}{800\times 2}\times 100\%=7\%\). The alternative reports the total two-year increase, \(\frac{112}{800}\times 100\%=14\%\), as an annual rate.
questions.hint: Simple interest uses the original principal throughout the stated time.

questions.concept: Simple Interest Rate for Doubling a Sum
questions.learningObjective: Determine the annual simple interest rate needed for a sum to double.
questions.question: A sum of money doubles in \(8\text{ years}\) at simple interest. What is the annual interest rate?
questions.explanation: Doubling means the interest equals the initial principal. Therefore \(1=8r\), so \(r=\frac{1}{8}=0.125=12.5\%\). The alternative treats the total doubled amount \(2P\) as the interest \(I\); the interest is only \(P\), leading to half that rate.
questions.hint: Distinguish the interest earned from the doubled final balance.
